narrative.northStar: A Minnesota Field Through the Season
narrative.overview:
The interface is the landscape it serves. Every color is a thing you can stand on or squint at in rural Minnesota: black-dirt soil, north-woods pine, a midsummer field, young sprouts, harvest gold, dawn light over stubble. The palette is never decorative — it is subject matter. Warmth comes from this commitment (earthy hues, slab-serif headlines, soil-tinted shadows), never from ornament, texture packs, or rustic kitsch.

This is a product-register system: design serves the workflow of farmers, food-shelf staff, and neighbors moving surplus crops to people who need them. Components are sturdy and plainspoken — built like good farm equipment: generous 44px targets, clear labels, solid fills, nothing to figure out.
keyCharacteristics: Palette drawn from a single physical scene, used semantically (gold = value, clay = error, field = action)
Slab-serif display reserved for big agrarian moments; civic sans everywhere else; mono for ledger numbers
Flat-ish surfaces with ambient, soil-tinted shadows — daylight, not UI chrome
44px minimum interactive targets (--control-min); the audience skews older
Motion is composed and reduced-motion-safe: composed static fallbacks, never merely disabled

rules.name: The Value-Wears-Gold Rule
rules.body: Harvest gold appears ONLY on rescued value: money pledged, points earned, funding goals, and their gauges. If gold is on something that isn't value, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Not-Cream Rule
rules.body: The background is Morning (#edf0ea) — a cool green-tinted neutral. Never drift it toward cream/beige/parchment.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Body text ≥4.5:1 against its background, always. When in doubt, step toward Soil.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Numbers that represent value are always set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals via the .num class.

rules.name: The Slab-Stops-at-H2 Rule
rules.body: Zilla Slab appears in h1/h2/display and the brand mark only. Display type in UI controls is prohibited.

rules.name: The Soil-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow derives from Soil (#2b2722), never neutral black.

rules.name: The Z-Scale Rule
rules.body: z-index is semantic: header 100 · modal 200–500 · toast 600 · skip-link 700. Arbitrary values are forbidden.

dos: Do honor --control-min: 44px minimum for anything tappable — the audience skews older.
Do set every value-number in Plex Mono .num with tabular numerals.
Do use the 3px Harvest focus outline on every focusable element — inputs included.
Do ship composed reduced-motion fallbacks, not just animation: none.
Do keep body text at ≥4.5:1; step toward Soil when close.
Do use the existing tokens; if a value isn't a token, ask whether it should exist at all.
donts: Don't build "generic corporate SaaS dashboards": no cold slate grays, no hero-metric stat cards, no identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't imitate "gig-economy app slickness" — no urgency patterns, no gradient-drenched CTAs.
Don't add "rustic kitsch": no barnwood textures, no script fonts.
Don't put Harvest gold on anything that isn't rescued value.
Don't use border-left/border-right thicker than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or decorative glassmorphism, ever.
Don't repeat the tracked-uppercase kicker above every section — one is voice, a cadence is AI scaffolding.
Don't drift the background warm: Morning is cool-green (#edf0ea), not cream.
Don't carry information in placeholders — hints live in visible sub-text lines.
